title: The spring's first day of channels on a home-plot-only farm
about: Spring 12, 09:00: only the home plot is bought (x 9-12, y 16-23; parsnips sown on its east column, dry). The creek runs; the spade is selected on the creek's open bank at (25,14). Channels go on any open farm ground: dig west along the corridor at y 14 (a culvert under the main road), then down x 13 beside the home plot: about 22 tiles, inside the flow of 24, and the home plot's east column is watered the next morning. Bought-plot edges still say "Not your land yet".
